role: post-freeze detection diagnostic; not a new V5 theorem family
setup: general two-time binary conservation identity; persistent-latent-link detection is the ecological observation-process specialization

direction.q_current_gt_q_previous: observed gain is more probable than observed loss despite no latent state change
direction.q_current_eq_q_previous: observed gain and loss are equally probable
direction.q_current_lt_q_previous: observed loss is more probable than observed gain despite no latent state change

villavicencio_audit.score: q_current - q_previous using transition-specific fitted p_previous,p_current and each dyad's focal-plant census counts
villavicencio_audit.endpoint: among observed binary changed dyads, ROC AUC ranking gain over loss
villavicencio_audit.interpretation: mechanistic observation-process diagnostic only; the score is not an independent ecological predictor

claim_ceiling: The general conservation identity proves that any change in marginal observed-presence probability creates a gain-minus-loss imbalance, without an independence assumption. The product/odds and q(n) special cases require their stated conditional-independence assumptions. None of these identities estimates how many Villavicencio changes are biological or validates ecological rewiring or routeability.

assumptions.general_difference_identity: none beyond a valid joint distribution for two binary observations
assumptions.persistent_link_specialization: latent link is present in both periods; q_previous/q_current are marginal period-level observed-presence probabilities
assumptions.product_and_odds_identities: period-level detections are conditionally independent given the persistent latent link
assumptions.independent_census_special_case: within-period census detections are conditionally independent with common per-census detection probability p
